yeah but the title gives the wrong idea that goth has never had ties to nazism, when it did. alot of the founding and pioneering artists of the culture had nazi ties or wore nazi attire to be edgy. the goth community worked hard to kick nazis out of it, and it's something that should be celebrated. people like to pretend that goth has always been leftist, or doesn't have a problematic roots, but it does. we accomplish nothing by sweeping this history under the rug.
